stock_evidence.finding: Ghidra shows the enabled byte store before mutex_lock.
Ghidra shows enabled check and disabled pending-level write outside mutex; mutex is acquired only in enabled branch.
Baseline stock function identity/entry evidence; current hardened functions are intentionally changed.

counterexamples.actor_a: fan_enable_store(0) writes enabled=false then is preempted before lock
counterexamples.actor_b: fan_level_store(5) observes disabled and writes pending_level=5 without lock
counterexamples.result: level 5 request is lost; final pending level becomes 3

counterexamples.actor_a: fan_enable_store(1) writes enabled=true then is preempted before lock
counterexamples.actor_b: fan_level_store(5) observes enabled, takes lock and applies level 5
counterexamples.actor_a_resume: takes lock, applies old pending level 3, then clears pending
counterexamples.result: later level 5 request can be overwritten by stale deferred level 3

changes.change: Acquire chip mutex before enabled comparison/publication; hold it through deferred level and PWM/regulator transition.
Acquire the same mutex before reading enabled; hold it through either pending-level write or fan_level_set.
Read enabled and selected current/pending level under chip mutex.
Publish current-level byte with WRITE_ONCE for asynchronous diagnostic reader.
Read current-level byte with READ_ONCE for start/stop diagnostics; IRQ/timer phase protocol otherwise unchanged.

lock_contract.nested_lock_order: No new nested locks; added sysfs paths take only chip mutex. Timer callback remains lockless and reads only the current-level diagnostic byte with READ_ONCE.

behavior_cost: fan_enable_show and fan_level_show can wait behind fan_speed_show, which holds chip mutex while sampling for approximately one second.
open_limits: No KCSAN/KCSAN or device-level race test was run.
The fan timer/IRQ sample-count concurrency semantics remain separate and are not changed by this patch.
